answer: The vine schedule is applied in lantern and lotus publishes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3598 identities would post 3998 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
